title: Seated Defensive Stance and Slide
description: Players hold a square, balanced defensive position and slide laterally to stay in front of a ball handler, the seated equivalent of a defensive stance and slide.

content.objective: Hold a square, balanced position and slide laterally to stay in front of the ball.
content.setup: Players start at the free-throw line, chair square to an imaginary ball handler.
instructions: Push laterally to the left elbow using even strokes on both wheels.
Push laterally back to the right elbow, staying square the whole way.
Repeat the pattern three times without turning the chair to face either direction.
Finish with five seconds of quick, short alternating pushes in place.
coachingPoints: Keep the chair square to the imaginary ball handler throughout.
Use short, quick pushes rather than long strokes for lateral movement.
Stay balanced — don't lean the trunk toward the direction of travel.
commonMistakes: Turning the chair to face the direction of travel instead of staying square.
Leaning so far that balance is lost.
Reaching with the hands instead of using chair position.
content.safety: Make sure the floor is clear of obstacles along the slide path.
